Merge two dictionaries.

Supplied answer
a = {"name": "Surya", "age": 23}
b = {"age": 24, "city": "Bhubaneswar"}
merged = {**a, **b} # works in Python 3.5+
print(merged) # age becomes 24 (b wins)
a.update(b) # changes a itself
print(a)
Note: When the same key exists in both, the value from the second dictionary wins.
